messages:
sara_cs: @eli_support quick FYI :rotating_light: Customer reported major grounding/citation loss after the v2 reranker+index rollout from this morning. They're seeing results with no citations and lower recall. Asked for triage.

eli_support: Can you paste the customer's repro (API call + prompt + before/after outputs)? Also which customer/org and model id? Do we have any alerts?

sara_cs: Pasting customer's repro below (redacted org id = ACME-CO). They sent original prompt and our responses pre-rollout vs post-rollout.

sara_cs: ```
# curl request
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retrieve -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{
  "org_id":"ACME-CO",
  "endpoint":"search",
  "query":"How do I refund an order placed with a gift card?",
  "params":{"reranker":"v2", "top_k":5}
}'
```

sara_cs: Pre-rollout response (yesterday):
- Result 1: "Refunds for gift cards..." (source: docs/payments.md#refunds) ✅
- Result 2: "Policy for gift card returns..." (source: policies/returns.md) ✅

sara_cs: Post-rollout (this morning):
- Result 1: "You can contact support to request a refund." (no source) ⚠️
- Result 2: "Refunds depend on payment method." (no source) ⚠️

sara_cs: Customer's note: recall looks much lower, citations missing. They attached a sample failing query and said rolling back fixed it for them.

vinay_research: :eyes: I saw similar signal in the nightly rerank eval — v2 reranker is returning higher confidence for generic spans and lower for anchored doc context. Need to check LTR weights and summary fusion.

maria_prodeng: Deploy bot shows a canary -> full rollout completed at 1951122200. @deploy-bot can you confirm the exact config change for reranker? Is it only model weights or also feature extraction? 

deploy-bot: [deploy] release/v2-reranker rolled from canary to 100% at 1951122200. Change set: reranker model weights (v2), feature-extractor: tokenizer patch (sticky-tokenizer 1.4), no retrieval index changes.

eli_support: Good. If tokenizer changed, that could impact sparse signal or reranker features. Can we reproduce locally? Vinay, can you run smoke eval on the failing queries against v1 and v2 reranker + same retrieval index? I can also pull traces.

vinay_research: Running now. I will post top-5 rerank scores + token diffs in ~15m.

sara_cs: Customer asked for an ETA on a fix and said they already failed a QA check. They're asking for a rollback if this is high risk.

ops-oncall: If rollback is required, we need a rollback plan. Maria — any risk to other customers? Is the rolling change reversible via traffic-splitting to v1? 

maria_prodeng: We can split traffic back to v1 reranker per org. I'll prepare a temporary routing rule to send ACME-CO to v1 and keep others on v2. Requires a quick config change and an emergency rollout of routing rules.

eli_support: In the meantime, can we ask the customer to append header X-Use-Reranker:v1 to their request as a workaround? Also collecting logs: @sara_cs can you get the request id and sample event ids from the customer? We need request ids to fetch traces.

sara_cs: Sent a reply & asked for request ids + samples. Customer responded with request ids: rq_8a3f, rq_8a7c. Also confirmed that adding ?use_reranker=v1 fixed their examples.

vinay_research: Smoke eval shows v2 reranker increases score for shorter generic passages and decreases for doc-anchored passages. Tokenizer patch changed subword splits for 'gift card' -> 'gift'+'card' -> affects phrase-match features. Root cause looks plausibly the tokenizer feature delta.

eli_support: Ok root cause hypothesis = tokenizer change in feature-extraction + reranker weights tuned to older tokenizer. Two immediate actions: 1) create per-org routing to v1 for ACME-CO; 2) reproduce across more customers and rollback tokenizer patch in feature-extractor if needed.

maria_prodeng: I'll push the routing rule now. ETA 10m. If rollback needed we'll schedule emergency patch.

sara_cs: Customer is grateful for the quick workaround. Keeping them in the loop. I'll update after routing rule is live.

deploy-bot: [routing] traffic-split rule applied: ACME-CO -> reranker v1 at 1951122450 by maria_prodeng.

sara_cs: Confirmed with customer — their failing queries now show sources again. They asked for a postmortem and timeline.

eli_support: Collecting traces for rq_8a3f and rq_8a7c and will attach correlation IDs. Also recommend running a broader regression sweep on top 200 customer queries overnight.

vinay_research: Will add tokenizer-stability tests to CI and coordinate a retrain of v2 weights with sticky-tokenizer 1.4 tokens. 

sara_cs: Thanks team — I told the customer we'll follow up with root cause analysis and time to permanent fix. :thumbsup:
